# Changelog

All notable changes to Syntra are recorded here.

## Unreleased

- Split the workspace into daemon, client and plugin tiers.
- Added independent client, plugin and machine-protocol contracts.
- Added runtime-tunable per-subsystem logging.
- Added manifest-driven plugin discovery and health reporting.
- Added capability-aware peer input and clipboard/file transfer paths.

## 0.11.0

Initial Syntra workspace release. See the repository history for implementation detail.
